_documentation: Lighthouse CI assertion config for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml (#270). Category thresholds sit below the day-to-day scores on purpose: the gate exists to catch collapses (a 1 MB image landing on a page, a render-blocking regression), not to flake on shared-runner variance. The performance floor is 0.70: the heaviest audited page (about.html, a long page with the deliverables Gantt + self-hosted fonts) measured a median 0.72 on the GitHub runner on 2026-07-16, after the July 2026 editorial pass first dropped it to a flapping 0.69-0.70 (#1355) and the reveal-animation exemption on page headers in #1352 won the margin back. The 2-point headroom is thin, so if flapping returns the next levers are trimming render-blocking site.css or a 0.65 floor (see #1355 for the analysis). A first 0.75 floor flaked on about.html at 0.74 in an earlier era. resource-summary:image:size warns when any audited page ships more than 500 KB of images, the class of regression the June 2026 press-kit fix removed. The workflow is not a required check, so a red run signals without blocking auto-merge.
